headline: Saudi Arabia Begins Construction on 70,000 SQM Expo 2030 Metro Station in Riyadh
summary: The Royal Commission for Riyadh City initiated construction on a 70,000-square-meter transit station for the Riyadh Metro. Designed to accommodate 19,000 passengers per hour, the facility supports urban mobility for Expo 2030.
why: Saudi Arabia is investing heavily in public transit and megaproject infrastructure ahead of major international conventions.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Public infrastructure development boosts domestic construction sector activity and commercial transport capacity.
